"Proof": name of an unconditional theorem in the dump with literally this statement, if any; otherwise the constant supplied for that hypothesis in some proof term (‡: it may be a theorem or a structure constructor, and may itself carry hypotheses); failing that, †. † does not mean unproved (the main theorem is verified unconditionally); only that no literally matching theorem is in this scope. Names are the code's names; what they refer to is not interpreted.*
